defs.def: to surprise sb very much 使十分惊讶；使大为惊奇；使吃惊

ex.s: Given the astonishing potential of AI to transform our lives, we all need to take action to deal with our AI-powered future, and this is where AI by Design: A Plan for Living with Artificial Intelligence comes in.
ex.t: 鉴于AI改变我们生活的惊人潜力，我们都需要采取行动来应对这个由AI驱动的未来，而这正是《AI by Design：与人工智能共处之计》一书的用武之地。

ex.s: And that’s why, however astonishing Project Debater may seem, the tradition that began with Socrates and Confucius will not end with artificial intelligence.
ex.t: 正因如此，无论Project Debater多么惊人，始于苏格拉底和孔子的传统不会随人工智能终结。

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

ex.s: Why was the young Jubilado astonished at the Bajau?
ex.t: 为什么年轻的 Jubilado 对巴瑶族感到惊讶？

ex.s: Wilson has   13   am astonishing 64, 000 miles, and has had countless pleasant and often humorous   14   with the students he transports to and from school.
ex.t: 威尔逊已经   13   惊人的64,000英里，并与他接送上下学的学生有过无数愉快、常带幽默的   14  。

ex.s: Elsewhere in Asia even more astonishing actions are being taken.
ex.t: 在亚洲其他地方，甚至更令人惊叹的行动正在被采取。

ex.s: Human beings will continue to adapt to the changing climate in both ordinary and astonishing ways.
ex.t: 人类将继续以普通和惊人的方式适应不断变化的气候。

ex.s: It is absolutely astonishing to see a superhighway world map made entirely of wires and cables.
ex.t: 看到完全由电线和电缆制成的高速公路世界地图，绝对令人惊讶。

ex.s: The murals cover an astonishing area of 45,000 square metres.
ex.t: 这些壁画覆盖了惊人的 45,000 平方米面积。

ex.s: Astonished, my mother went to take a closer look.
ex.t: 母亲惊讶地走上前去仔细看了看。

ex.s: Standing in the distance, they were astonished to see misty clouds rising from the great Niagara Falls, which is on the south side of the lake.
ex.t: 站在远处，他们惊讶地看到薄雾般的云层从大尼亚加拉瀑布升起，瀑布位于湖的南侧。
